messages.author: 061281a8cdc1f42e
messages.subject: Reverse sign of specific 'a' parameters
parts:
Is there a way in mirt() and/or itemplot() to reverse the sign of specific 'a' parameters? Essentially, I'd like to flip the positive and negative ends of one specific dimension for presentation purposes. If running an CFA or EFA, I would just constrain the loadings to be the same magnitude but opposite signs and I'm wondering if I can do something like that in mirt().  

Thanks!

messages.author: 061281a8cdc1f42e
messages.subject: Re: Reverse sign of specific 'a' parameters
parts:
Never mind - I figured out how to do this seeing one Phil's past comments using starting values. For anyone else interested, here was my solution: 

#saves model starting values
svs = mirt(data, model, pars = "values")...

#parmnum can be found by print(svs)
#the theoretically negatively loading items had positive starting values
#setting the starting values to negative flips the scaling of the factor
svs$values[parmnum] = svs$values[parmnum]*-1

#re-run mirt using augmented starting values
fit = mirt(data, model, pars=svs)

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Reverse sign of specific 'a' parameters
parts:
Perfect :). I would add one more thing though: if you want to return the exact starting values, also pass TOL = NaN. This causes the optimizer to instantly converge, leaving everything as-is. Cheers.

Phil

messages.subject: Re: Reverse sign of specific 'a' parameters
parts:
Hi Dr. Chalmers,

As I had the same issue, so I found this post which is very helpful. However,  I found that when I tried to flip positive and negative ends for one or two specific dimensions, the other parameters also changed to negative, which I also don't want. 

Flip all the parameter (which is not idea):

sv <- mirt(d2_orig,7,  method = "MHRM",
             calcNull = TRUE, technical = list(NCYCLES = 5000),verbose = F,QMC=T,
             pars = 'values')
sv$value[sv$name =='a1']<-sv$value[sv$name =='a1']*-1
sv$value[sv$name =='a2']<-sv$value[sv$name =='a2']*-1

mod7_orig <- mirt(d2_orig,7,  method = "MHRM",
               calcNull = TRUE, technical = list(NCYCLES = 5000),verbose = F,QMC=T,
               pars = sv)
 
I am wondering is there a way that I could only flip the positive and negative ends for one or two specific parameters, and other parameters will not be influenced? 

Thank you very much!
Yuanjin

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Reverse sign of specific 'a' parameters
parts:
Your model is very high-dimensional, so no doubt the estimation algorithm is just moving towards an equivalent (but sign changed) ML location. I would recommend just multiplying the columns of the slope parameters by -1 after the model has converged to change the signs as needed. HTH.

Phil
